random_dictionary_control.encoder: random unit encoder directions, Gaussian row-normalised; d_sae=32768 matched to qwen-scope; sparsity matched by top-k calibrated to the trained SAE's mean L0 (~50)
random_dictionary_control.note: NOT the trained qwen-scope dictionary. Without this field a random-dictionary graph is indistinguishable from a trained-SAE graph of the same checkpoint.
